## Highlights
- **🗂️ Tidier project folders.** The `files-and-notes` folder is gone: its two files, `materials.js` and `materials.css`, now live in `content/` with the other main scripts.

## Changes
- Nothing changes in Alma. Attached files, links, My notes and paperclip counts work exactly the same, and your saved files and notes are kept.
- The Safari version for iPad (`alma-plus.user.js`, attached below) is rebuilt to match.

## How to update
1. **Chrome:** download the zip below and copy its files over your Alma+ folder (you can delete the old `files-and-notes` folder afterwards), then click reload ↻ on Alma+ in `chrome://extensions`.
2. **iPad (Safari):** Userscripts updates the script on its own.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the Chrome extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks.
